(S3) negative: sub-intervals shifted by two steps (wrong origin) no longer meet the step-272 end strings (or are refused)
(S4) negative: the unlike source contraction with the like chord on step 272 empties (inconsistent root) or is refused

(S5) KNOWN through the subdivided path: exact cubic history as exact synthetic records; each of 4 sub-interval enclosures of l'' on the receiver step [4.80, 4.81] contains the exact l'' at its ends and middle
